author: hand_authored_by_PI
purpose: Calibration task with unambiguous thresholds. All systems should produce a complete anchor extraction. Failure indicates configuration issue, not a result.
request_text: Generate the weekly vulnerability scan compliance report for the CIO covering the past 7 days. The report must include: (1) total count of critical and high severity vulnerabilities from our Tenable Nessus scans, broken out by asset group; (2) percentage of critical vulnerabilities older than 30 days, with a minimum acceptable threshold of 95% remediated within that window; (3) trend chart comparing this week to the prior 4-week rolling average. Deliver as a PDF document, 5 to 8 pages, by Friday at 1700 hours. Use only data from our internal Tenable Nessus instance; do not include third-party threat feeds. Classification: UNCLASSIFIED.

expected_anchor.mission_intent: Provide CIO with weekly vulnerability compliance posture report covering past 7 days

minimum.threshold: all critical and high severity from Tenable Nessus
vulnerability count by asset group, aging percentage, trend chart
at least 95% of critical vulnerabilities remediated within 30 days

notes_for_lead_analyst: This task is intentionally over-specified. A correctly-configured MANDATE pipeline should extract all 6 minimum dimensions and 3 constraints. Baselines should do similarly well on extraction; differences will emerge in structured output format and trace completeness.
